subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers adopt one of the conflicting fork PRs for this Feishu URL bug, or sponsor a fresh same-repository fix?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but the same-repository attempts are closed and the open fork candidates are conflicting, so automation should not open another duplicate branch until maintainers pick the repair path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue one narrow Feishu-plugin fix that uses the closed/fork PRs as source context, adds focused tests, and requires live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt a fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage plus live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue one narrow Feishu-plugin fix that uses the closed/fork PRs as source context, adds focused tests, and requires live Feishu proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent Feishu outbound-runtime history make vincentkoc the strongest routing candidate for this repair choice.
